snippet.title: The Citadel Must Hold - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Build a fortress-city, explore a dangerous wilderness, and hold against increasingly deadly Monster Tides. The Citadel Must Hold is a base-building survival RTS where pausable real-time battles, hero-led exploration, and powerful choices shape every run.

Wishlist The Citadel Must Hold on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4891190/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=store_launch 

Discord: https://discord.gg/zt3hr7hjwU 
Site: https://citadelmusthold.com 

Developed by Klenisho Games.
